gates.notes: G6 C: Kering Beaute is a bolt-on (~EUR4bn vs ~EUR200bn+ market cap). China exposure material but not Chinese domicile. G7: UK small.

bull_points: Category leader with ~12% global share and accelerating growth (Q3-26 adj. LFL 7.7%) (S1)
Structural beauty-market growth plus premiumisation and derm runway
Strong balance sheet and anchor shareholders
bear_points: China/North Asia and travel-retail volatility; 2024-25 slowdown (S1)
Valuation typically premium; Kering Beaute price ~EUR4bn adds integration risk
Dupes/indie brands and social-commerce disruption in mass beauty
thesis_breakers: North Asia decline >5% for two consecutive quarters
